inventory.sourceFigureDescription: A vector diagram of the T helper cell: surface TCR/CD3/CD4 and IL-2R (blocked by Basiliximab); the calcineurin pathway (Cyclophilin + Cyclosporine and FKBP + Tacrolimus complexes blocking Calcineurin so NFAT-P cannot drive IL-2 transcription); the mTOR pathway (Sirolimus/rapamycin via FKBP); the NF-kB pathway (Glucocorticoids blocking inflammatory cytokine genes); and the de novo purine synthesis arm (Azathioprine/6-MP, Mycophenolate, PRPP amidotransferase, IMP dehydrogenase → Purine nucleotides → DNA replication).
